answer_1.quote: Visual storytelling (VIST) aims at crafting a narrative from a sequence of ordered images... Our model aims to generate a multi-sentence story S by predicting the probability P (S|I).

answer_2.quote: We validate our results over the test set using the standard metrics BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr and SPICE. We evaluate the generated text in terms of text-text semantic similarity using BLEURT, image-text semantic similarity using CLIP-Score, and language fluency using Perplexity.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on a sample of generated texts... We invite 75 human annotators from Prolific to rate stories on a 5-point Likert scale for the criteria of Visual Grounding, Coherence, Interestingness, and Informativeness.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to rate each story‑image pair on four criteria using a 5‑point Likert scale.
